351: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ; ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
Says Nanak, how can He remain hidden? He distributed the jewels, one by one. ॥4॥7॥
ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
Good deeds and conduct are the vine spreading out, and the Lord's Name is its fruit.
ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ. ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ; ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
The Name has no form or outline; the unstruck sound-current resonates; through the Word, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ॥1॥
One who knows the Lord speaks of Him,
and he alone drinks in the nectar. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ. ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ; ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are snapped.
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
When one's light merges into the Light within, the pursuit of the profits of Maya is abandoned. ॥2॥
ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
In all lights, I see Your form; all the worlds are Your Maya.
ਰਾਰੈ. ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Amidst the conflict of the world, He sits detached in His form; He casts His glance through the reflections within all. ॥3॥
ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The true Yogi plays the vina of the Word, beholding the infinitely beautiful form of the Lord.
ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ. ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
Imbued with the unstruck Word, he is dyed in the love of that Lord; Nanak speaks this reflection. ॥4॥8॥
ਮੈ ਗੁਣ; ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
My only virtues are that I carry the burden of my words upon my head.
The only words worth speaking are the words of the Creator Lord.
Eating, drinking and laughing are useless,
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
as long as the Lord is not remembered in the heart. ॥1॥
Why should anyone care about anything else,
ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if, in this human life, one gathers what is truly worth gathering? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
Whatever one says is utterly false, the falsest of the false.
So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,
when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ॥2॥
ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
As You make us, so do we become.
Without You, there is no other at all.
ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.
As it pleases You, so do You lead us. ॥3॥
The jewel-like Ragas, with their consorts and their whole family,
produce the sublime nectar if the Name wells up within them.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ. ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
By His grace, He has come into my home; my companions have met together to celebrate the marriage.
ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Beholding this play, my mind has become blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ॥1॥
So sing, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.
ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ. ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ; ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.
ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ. ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ॥2॥
ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ. ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ; ਹੋਰਨਿ. ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.
ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ, ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, compassion and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ॥3॥
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ. ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
She upon whom He casts His glance of grace becomes the happy soul-bride. ॥4॥10॥
Home and forest are the same, for one who lives in intuitive balance.
His evil-mindedness departs, and the praises of God take its place.
To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.
352: Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own true home. ॥1॥
One who has subdued the mind is like one who knows the six Shastras.
He sees the perfect Lord God, the Light, in all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With great thirst within, one puts on many religious robes;
the pain of corruption drives peace from the body.
Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth from within;
but by giving up duality, one is saved through the Name. ॥2॥
In the Lord's praise and adoration is intuitive peace and bliss;
the love of the Lord of the universe is one's family and friend.
He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ; ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His command. ॥3॥
Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering to the body.
All religious robes and social classes look like dust.
Whatever is born comes and goes.
O Nanak, only the Name and the Lord's command are eternal and everlasting. ॥4॥11॥
In the one pool there is a lotus of incomparable beauty.
It blossoms continually; its form is fragrant.
The swans pick up the bright jewels;
they take on the essence of the all-powerful Lord of the universe. ॥1॥
Whoever is seen is subject to birth and death.
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ; ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
How rare are those who know and understand this secret.
The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.
One whose consciousness merges with the knowledge of the Lord's sound-current and spiritual seed
serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ॥2॥
One who is imbued with the Lord's love and dwells upon Him lovingly is liberated.
He is the king of kings, and ever blossoms forth.
One whom You preserve, by bestowing Your mercy, O Lord —
even the sinking stone You carry across. ॥3॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
His light is in the three worlds; He is known throughout the three worlds.
ਉਲਟ ਭਈ; ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
When the mind turns away from Maya, one brings the Lord's home into one's own home.
Day and night, such a one performs devotional worship, lovingly attuned to the Lord.
Through the true teachings of the Guru, arguments depart.
But through too much cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.
The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name;
by the Guru's grace, one remains lovingly attuned. ॥1॥
He is ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ; ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Pain and pleasure are in the hands of God, the True Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who practises falsehood comes and goes.
By speaking and talking, his limit cannot be found.
ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ; ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
What can he see? He has no understanding.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Without the Name, the mind is not satisfied. ॥2॥
Those who are born are afflicted with disease,
tormented by the pain of ego and Maya.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
They alone are saved, who are protected by God;
serving the True Guru, they taste the nectar. ॥3॥
One who restrains the fickle mind tastes the nectar.
Serving the True Guru, one speaks the ambrosial Word.
Through the True Word, one obtains liberation and the supreme state.
O Nanak, such a one sheds self-conceit from within. ॥4॥13॥
ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Whatever He has made has become true.
The True Guru has given the Ambrosial Name.
With the Name in the heart, the mind is never separated from Him.
Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ॥1॥
O Dear Lord, please keep me in Your sanctuary.
353: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have obtained the treasure of the Name, and the nine treasures. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those whose karma and dharma — whose actions and faith — are in the True Name of the True Lord —
I am forever a sacrifice to them.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted.
In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Blessed is that bride who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.
She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word.
She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.
She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ॥3॥
The True Name is my social status and honour.
Love for the Truth is my karma and dharma, and my self-control.
O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.
Some come, and having come, they then depart.
Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.
ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.
ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
From the perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.
ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ. ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us to cross over. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
Those whom God unites with Himself
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ; ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ॥2॥
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Tell me: who should we call good or bad?
Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.
I speak the unspoken speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's teachings.
I join the Guru's congregation, and I find God's limits. ॥3॥
The Shastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;
bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines — all are found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.
The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, the Name abides in the heart by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ॥4॥15॥
ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.
ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within my heart; see this, and understand. ॥1॥
So speak the Name of the Lord, which shall emancipate you.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ; ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ. ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the divine light shines forth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ. ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ; ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism and doubt do not depart from within.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then one realises one's destiny. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; one who enshrines the Beloved, the ocean of peace, within the heart —
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
the Lord, the Lover of His devotees, the Life of the world, the Giver of understanding — the Lord saves that one through the Guru's teachings. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
O Nanak, if the Life of the world bestows His mercy, one is intuitively attuned to the love of the Lord. ॥4॥16॥
ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ. ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ. ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let them understand themselves.
ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ. ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
Whom do they teach? Through study, they come to understand the Lord's glorious virtues; through the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment. ॥1॥
354: Through such teachings of the Guru, dwell upon the Lord who pervades all bodies;
ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Lord, profound and unfathomable. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Endless are the waves of loving devotion to the Lord.
Those who dwell night and day in the company of the Lord's praises are pure.
Useless is the birth of the faithless cynic in this world.
The humble devotee of the Lord remains detached. ॥2॥
The body is sanctified by singing the Lord's glorious praises.
Realising one's own self, one remains lovingly attuned to the Lord.
The Primal Lord is infinite, beyond the beyond, a jewel beyond price.
Imbued with the Beloved, my mind is steady and content. ॥3॥
Those who merely talk and speak are dead.
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
God is not far away; O God, You are right here.
They see the whole world as the shadow of Maya;
O Nanak, they meditate on the Name, through the Guru's teachings. ॥4॥17॥
One is a beggar, living on charity;
another is a king, absorbed in himself.
One receives honour, and another, dishonour.
One builds up and tears down, and keeps on thinking.
No one is greater than You, O Lord.
Whom should I present as good? ॥1॥
For me, Your Name alone is my support.
You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I do not find the way; I go astray.
I find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord.
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
I am mentally blind, bound by Maya.
The body grows weaker and wears out each day.
I have high hopes of eating and living;
yet my every breath and morsel is in Your account. ॥2॥
Night and day, He gives the lamp to the blind,
and takes care of the one drowning in the terrifying world-ocean.
Those who speak of the Name, hear it and believe in it —
I am a sacrifice to them.
my soul and body are all Yours, Lord. ॥3॥
ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
When You bless me, I chant Your Name;
then I find a place to sit in Your Court.
ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,
and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.
When the Lord bestows His glance of grace, one meets the True Guru.
Prays Nanak, then one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ॥4॥18॥
ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ. ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ; ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ. ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
The cow without milk, the bird without wings, and the garden without water are of no use.
ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ. ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ; ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
What is an emperor without anyone to salute him? The chamber of the soul is dark, without Your Name. ॥1॥
Why should You forget me? I would suffer such great pain!
ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I would suffer great pain; please do not let me forget You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ. ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕੰਨੀ. ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.
ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ. ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
One walks on one's feet only when led by another; without serving the Lord, these are the fruits that are borne. ॥2॥
ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ, ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ; ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
The Word is the tree, the heart is the garden, the fertile field; tend it and irrigate it with the Lord's love.
ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ; ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
All these trees bear the fruit of the One Name; but without the grace of good deeds, how can anyone obtain it? ॥3॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ. ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
As many beings as there are, all are Yours; without serving You, no one obtains any reward.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Pain and pleasure come by Your will; without the Name, the soul does not endure. ॥4॥
ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ. ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ; ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
To die in the teachings is to live; otherwise, what is life? If I live otherwise, it is not the true way of living.
355: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ; ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
Says Nanak, the Lord gives life to the living; please, Lord, keep me as You please. ॥5॥19॥
Let your body be the Brahmin, and let your mind be the loin-cloth;
let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ring of kusha grass.
I seek the Lord's Name and His praise as my charity;
by the Guru's grace, I am absorbed in God. ॥1॥
O Pandit, contemplate God in this way,
ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ. ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ; ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so that His Name may sanctify you; His Name is your study, and His Name is your wisdom and way of life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ; ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
The outward sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the light is in the body.
So make the remembrance of the Name your loin-cloth and the ritual mark on your forehead;
here and hereafter, it alone shall stand by you.
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ. ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ॥2॥
Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.
Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek any other.
Become aware of reality, in the sky of the tenth gate;
read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ॥3॥
With the diet of His love, doubt and fear depart.
With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.
Let the knowledge of the One God be the ritual mark on your forehead;
the realisation that God is within you — let this be your discrimination. ॥4॥
God cannot be won over through ritualistic actions,
nor can His value be estimated by reciting sacred texts.
ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ; ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The eighteen Puranas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery;
O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ॥5॥20॥
He alone is a servant, slave and humble devotee,
who as Gurmukh becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
The One who created the universe shall ultimately destroy it.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Without Him, there is no other at all. ॥1॥
Contemplating the True Name through the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
the Gurmukh is found true in the True Court. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The true petition, the true prayer —
the Lord and Master in His mansion hears and applauds.
He summons the truthful to His heavenly throne,
and blesses them with glorious greatness; what He wills comes to pass. ॥2॥
Yours is the strength, You are my only support.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true insignia.
One who obeys the Lord's command goes to Him openly.
With the true insignia, his way is not blocked. ॥3॥
The Pandit reads and expounds the Vedas,
but he does not know the secret of the real thing within himself.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the Guru, understanding and realisation are not obtained;
but still, God, the True One, is pervading everywhere. ॥4॥
What should I say, speak or describe?
You Yourself know all, O Lord of wonders.
O Nanak, the support of the One Lord's door
is the true sustenance of the Gurmukh. ॥5॥21॥
ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ; ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
The body is an unbaked clay pot, wretched; it suffers pain in birth and death.
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ. ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ. ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
How can this treacherous world-ocean be crossed? Without the Lord and the Guru, it cannot be crossed. ॥1॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
Without You, there is no other for me, O my Beloved; without You, there is no other for me at all, O Lord.
ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are in all colours and forms; He forgives the one whom He blesses with His glance of grace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ. ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ, ਨ ਦੇਵੈ; ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ. ਨ ਦੇਇ, ਬੁਰੀ ॥
My mother-in-law, Maya, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet my Husband Lord.
ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ. ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His grace, through the Guru's mercy. ॥2॥
356: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ. ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
As You keep me, so do I live; You are the Giver of peace and pain; whatever You do comes to pass. ॥3॥
ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ; ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the three qualities.
ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
The Gurmukh obtains the state of the fourth condition, grasping the support of the congregation of the saints. ॥4॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart is filled with the unseen, inscrutable Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name finds, through the Guru's teachings, intuitive service. ॥5॥22॥
Attachment to family, attachment to all your affairs —
renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ॥1॥
ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ; ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,
ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,
the mind, Maya's child, no longer weeps, and the mother no longer grieves. ॥2॥
In this attachment, the world is drowning.
Only a rare Gurmukh crosses over. ॥3॥
In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.
Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of death. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ; ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Some receive instruction from a teacher, and practise meditation and penance,
ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ; ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
but their attachment is not broken, and they are not accepted. ॥5॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
When the Lord casts His glance of grace, this attachment departs.
O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ॥6॥23॥
He Himself does everything, the True Lord, unseen and infinite.
I am a sinner; You are the Forgiver. ॥1॥
By Your will, everything comes to pass.
One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The intellect of the self-willed is engrossed in falsehood.
Without the Lord's remembrance, it suffers in sin. ॥2॥
Renounce evil-mindedness, and earn some profit.
Whatever is born comes from the unseen, inscrutable Lord. ॥3॥
Such is my Friend and Helper.
Meeting the Guru, the Lord, devotion is implanted within me. ॥4॥
In all other dealings, one suffers loss.
O Nanak, the Lord's Name is pleasing to the mind of the one who prospers. ॥5॥24॥
When one contemplates and reflects upon knowledge, one becomes a benefactor to others.
ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ; ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
When one conquers the five passions, one comes to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ॥1॥
The ankle-bells truly vibrate when the mind is attached to the Lord.
ਤਉ ਜਮੁ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ; ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So what can the messenger of death do to me in the world hereafter? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When one abandons hope and desire, one becomes a true renunciate.
ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
When one practises abstinence like the Yogi, then one truly enjoys the household life. ॥2॥
One who has compassion, and contemplates the purity of the body, is the true naked ascetic.
He kills his own self, and does not kill others. ॥3॥
You, O Lord, are the One, and Yours are the many guises.
Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ॥4॥25॥
ਏਕ ਨ. ਭਰੀਆ; ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
I am not stained with only one fault, that I could wash it away by acquiring virtue.
ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the whole night of my life. ॥1॥
In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?
ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
357: With hope and thirst, I approach His bed,
ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ; ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ. ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the vision of the Lord, I cannot survive. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ. ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ. ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
I have not tasted His love, and my thirst is not quenched.
My youth is gone, and now I, the bride, repent and regret. ॥3॥
Even now, I am awake with hope and thirst;
I have grown sad, and I remain free of worldly hope. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When she sheds her ego, and adorns herself,
then her Husband Lord enjoys His bride on His bed. ॥4॥
Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the mind of her Husband Lord;
ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ; ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥26॥
In this world of my parents' home, I, the bride, have been very childish;
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ; ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
I did not realise the value of my Husband Lord. ॥1॥
ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.
If He bestows His glance of grace, then I shall meet Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the world beyond, my in-laws' home, the bride shall realise Truth;
she shall come to know the intuitive peace and poise of her Husband Lord. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace, such wisdom comes to her,
so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the mind of her Husband Lord. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the love and fear of God
enjoys her Husband Lord on His bed forever. ॥4॥27॥
ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ; ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
No one is anyone's son, and no one is anyone's mother.
Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ॥1॥
O my Lord and Master, I am created by You.
ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When You give it to me, I chant Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's door,
but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.
Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,
then one is absorbed into the Truest of the true. ॥4॥28॥
ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ. ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ; ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
In that pool of the world, people have their homes; there, the Lord created water and fire.
ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ. ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ; ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ. ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
Stuck in the mud of earthly attachment, their feet cannot move; I have seen them drowning there. ॥1॥
ਮਨ. ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ; ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
O my mind, you do not remember the One Lord, you foolish mind!
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As you forget the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ. ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ; ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
I am not celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I have been born foolish and ignorant into this world.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ; ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ. ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
Prays Nanak, I seek the sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord. ॥2॥29॥
ਛਿਅ ਘਰ. ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ; ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings,
but the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ॥1॥
That house in which the praises of the Creator are sung —
ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ; ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
preserve that house; in it lies your greatness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ; ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
The seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks and months,
and the various seasons originate from the one sun;
O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ॥2॥30॥
358: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ. ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ; ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
You may have hundreds of thousands of armies, hundreds of thousands of musicians and lancers, and hundreds of thousands of men who rise to salute you.
ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ. ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ; ਲਖ ਉਠਿ. ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Your rule may extend over hundreds of thousands of miles, and hundreds of thousands of men may rise to honour you.
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
But if your honour is of no account to the Lord, then all your efforts are useless. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.
ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ; ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ. ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ; ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ. ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
You may earn hundreds of thousands, gather and spend hundreds of thousands; hundreds of thousands may come, and hundreds of thousands may go.
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
But if your honour is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a place of rest? ॥2॥
ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ; ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Hundreds of thousands of Shastras may be explained, and hundreds of thousands of Pandits may read the Puranas;
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
but if your honour is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ॥3॥
ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ. ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Honour comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His grace. ॥4॥1॥31॥
ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.
ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the messenger of death. ॥1॥
O people, do not make fun of me.
ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ; ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
The Lord is my festive dish of rice-balls on leaf plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.
ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ; ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ॥2॥
ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ. ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
The Lord's praise is my river Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.
ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ; ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day I enshrine love for You. ॥3॥
ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ; ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
The rice-balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmin who eats them!
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ; ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, the rice-balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ॥4॥2॥32॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ; ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
Longing for the vision of the Lord, the gods suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.
ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
The Yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ॥1॥
For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.
ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ. ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ; ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ. ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Names are so many, and Your forms are endless; no one can tell how many glorious virtues You have. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ; ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.
ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ. ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ; ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ॥2॥
ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ; ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.
ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your door. ॥3॥
ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ; ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
Some wear skins and beg from door to door, carrying wooden staffs and deer-skins; others wear the tuft of hair, the sacred thread and loin-cloths.
ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ; ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
You are the Lord Master, I am only Your puppet; prays Nanak, what of my social status? ॥4॥1॥33॥
359: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The five evil passions dwell hidden within my mind.
ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ; ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
My mind does not stay steady with the Merciful Lord.
ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.
When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ॥2॥
I have five companions, and one Spouse.
They are rooted in the body, but the soul is destined to depart. ॥3॥
ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ॥4॥1॥34॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
If the soul-bride makes the pearl of her mind into a necklace, strung on the thread of the breath,
ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
and adorns her body with the decoration of compassion, then the Beloved will enjoy His beloved bride. ॥1॥
O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ; ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your glorious virtues are not found in any other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ. ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and uses the Lord as her toothbrush;
ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ. ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
if she wears the bracelet of the service of the Creator Lord around her wrists, then her consciousness is held steady. ॥2॥
ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silk clothes.
ਧੀਰਜੁ. ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ. ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the cream of the Lord, the Great Lover. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ; ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
If she lights the lamp in the temple of her mind, and makes her body the bed,
ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ. ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ; ਤ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, O Nanak, He takes her and enjoys her. ॥4॥1॥35॥
ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O brother?
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be employed to affect Him? ॥1॥
The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Nanak, he alone is blessed with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ. ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
The deeds are pre-ordained; no one can change the order.
ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ. ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ; ਮੇਟਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ॥2॥
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ; ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
Whoever talks too much in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.
ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chess pieces do not reach their goal. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.
ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a true human being. ॥4॥2॥36॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ; ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Whatever the Lord does, look upon it as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of intuitive Yoga. ॥1॥
360: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ, ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ; ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
O Baba, he alone is a Yogi, who is united with the Lord throughout the ages, absorbed in the Supreme Essence.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has obtained the Ambrosial Name of the Immaculate Lord; through spiritual wisdom, he enjoys this essence in his body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ, ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ; ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
In the city of the Lord, he sits in his Yogic posture, renouncing desires and conflicts.
ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ. ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
The sound of the horn of the Word ever rings out its beautiful melody; day and night, he is filled with the sound-current. ॥2॥
ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ. ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ. ਡੰਡਾ; ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
Reflective meditation is my cup, spiritual wisdom my walking stick; to behold the Lord ever-present is the ashes I apply to my body.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ. ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
The praise of the Lord is my occupation, and living as Gurmukh is my path of detachment. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ, ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ; ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
To see the Lord's light in all, though they are of many colours and forms, is my armrest.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ॥4॥3॥37॥
ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your fragrant flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.
ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ; ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup; thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ॥1॥
ਬਾਬਾ. ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ, ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Name, drinking in its nectar; it remains absorbed in intuitive love.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Night and day, one remains lovingly attuned to the Lord's love, holding fast to the unstruck Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ. ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ; ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ, ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
The Perfect True One naturally gives the cup of truth to the one upon whom He casts His glance of grace.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
One who trades in this nectar — how could he love the shallow wine of the world? ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
The teachings of the Guru, the ambrosial Bani — drinking them in, one becomes acceptable.
ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
One who loves the vision of the Lord's door — what use does he have for liberation or paradise? ॥3॥
ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ. ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
Imbued with the Lord's praises, one is forever a renunciate, and does not lose his life in the gamble.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ॥4॥4॥38॥
Having attacked Khuraasaan, Babar terrified Hindustan.
ਆਪੈ. ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ; ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mughal as the messenger of death.
ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ; ਤੈਂ. ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
There was so much slaughter that the people screamed; did You not feel compassion, Lord? ॥1॥
O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.
ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If some powerful man strikes out against another powerful man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ. ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ; ਖਸਮੈ. ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.
ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂ‍ੀ; ਮੁਇਆ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.
ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ. ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ; ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your glorious greatness. ॥2॥

One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,
